command: BPFREJIT_CORPUS_APPS="cilium/agent" BPFREJIT_SHIM_NATIVE_LOADER=post SAMPLES=3 WORKLOAD_DURATION=30 JOBS=8 IMAGE_BUILD_JOBS=8 TIMEOUT=3600 make corpus

derived_counts.note: Fresh native-post generation; the paper's declared 113/22 loader split and 89-object count are not merged with these figures. The paper's native-file count is not reproduced from this tree and is not derived.

environment: tracked devcontainer toolchain; Docker-in-Docker; local x86 KVM guest via virtme-ng
log_normalization: Guest-console carriage returns and trailing horizontal whitespace normalized in the retained copy.
manifest_provenance: Every (program, native_object) pair in the retained post-phase shim log resolves in the retained staged manifest copy; the staged manifest mtime (2026-09-24T16:34:00) predates the run start.
scope: Fresh local KVM native-loader evidence for Cilium only. It derives loader decision counts and manifest object counts from the retained shim log and staged manifest; it does not re-measure the paper's June native-post run, which retained no shim log.
